discussion_comments.comment_body: Thanks for the range check. Right now it only runs on declarations in `source-locations/`. A small global check would catch more: for every output node with a numeric `start`/`end` and a `loc.index`, assert `start === loc.start.index`, `end === loc.end.index`, and `start <= end`. Locally that gives 0 failures in TS and 36 in Rust, all from the outlined JSX issue. Could you add it for both backends?

The shared snapshot harness now checks ranges across the whole output AST for both backends, preserving shifted and missing/partial offsets from the input. Five regression tests cover these cases. Both backends pass all 1,832 fixtures.

Seems like this has gone back and forth a couple times. As a follow up there could be a test that starts the app both with internals showing and not showing.

Also/alternatively adding some testID to the tabs would allow for better selecting. like `'[data-testid="config-tab"] .monaco-editor'`
Yup, I'm actually cleaning up/adding more tests in another PR right now so this will be addressed there.
